description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver for the Ubiquiti RGB LED controller (LEDBAR), handling I2C communication, GPIO control, and LED brightness management.

classes.name: ubnt_ledbar
classes.description: Structure representing the LED controller device, including mutex, GPIOs, I2C client, and LED class devices.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_perform_transaction
methods.description: Performs an I2C transaction by writing a sequence of bytes and reading the response.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_apply_state
methods.description: Applies the current LED brightness state to the hardware via I2C transactions.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_reset
methods.description: Resets and initializes the LED controller hardware.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_set_red_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the red LED and updates hardware state.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_set_green_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the green LED and updates hardware state.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_set_blue_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the blue LED and updates hardware state.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_init_led
methods.description: Initializes an individual LED class device.

methods.name: ubnt_ledbar_probe
methods.description: Probe function called during device initialization, sets up GPIOs, resets hardware, and registers LEDs.
